subject: STABLE lowering-air-opus: AIR-only codegen in shared tree (C6t candidate); CA/SpringBoard corpus fully covered; 2 root decisions
body: SOURCES: render_pipeline.inc 090214d3 (tegu_render_compile_air_first: AIR-only, TEGU_AIR_REFUSED + nil, env/build switch TEGU_AIR_DIRECT / TEGU_AIR_DIRECT_DEFAULT=1; 3-arg tegu_render_generic_set_modules kept for harnesses), pipeline_cache_frontend.inc 151736d2 (TEGU_PC_MALI_AIR_OPTIONS cache kind, salt AIR1, creation record), render_encoder.inc 80b55509 (TEGU_PERF_AIR air/refused/no_air_source/air_ms), air_bridge.rs 30876dcb + .h 25b0e083 (tegu_air_library_air_source), mali_graphics_air.inc cc47f4fd, air/air_to_nir.c ecaee269 + air_intrinsics.c 0ad336d5 (nord2: odd-width ints, bool returns, branch cond, callee returns, sinpi/cospi/tanpi), build_native_compilers.py/build_callable_compilers.py (-DTEGU_MALI_AIR + air/). BUILT: host bridge 63c2e66f, host mesa-build Mali cb09b820 (AIR), iOS libNord2Mali.a 4d07ca9d (AIR, arm64 compiles), iOS Rust staticlib rebuilt. TRANSITIONAL (in code comment): m2v translation still runs at creation ONLY for planner metadata; no m2v code is compiled for generic render draws. NOT YET AIR: compute pipelines (still m2v->compute_v2: no AIR compute adapter yet) and the special package classes (fixed-UI R80/R85, compositor V6/V7/B3, attachment-clear exact) which use their own m2v compile entries. GATES: run_host_tests TEGU_AIR_DIRECT=0 green incl iOS strict link; CA host test PASS 47 with AIR engaged; integration --candidate AIR=0: only known CA 66/42 + candidate provenance (receipt for the rebuilt cdylib: root's check_compute_v2_real_producer step). AIR=1 extra failures: api_surface, render variant cache, variant threads = fixtures written as LLVM-23 IR (not Apple AIR; reader refuses), so AIR-only correctly returns nil. DECIDE: run fixture plumbing tests with TEGU_AIR_DIRECT=0 or regenerate fixtures as Apple AIR. COVERAGE (installed graphics corpus, AIR-only vs m2v baseline): CA 141 cases: all m2v-compilable compile (24 captured-fixed-ui covered by the 234/234 captured CA corpus); ui_frameworks: 17 left (8 tessellation LocalAuthenticationPrivateUI/MTLSpline, 3 PencilKit binding/fetch, 2 AppleMetalGL int16 colour, 2 bicubic MediaCoreUI/SeymourUI, 1 PhotosUICore texture-pointer load, 1 RenderBox fetch). Non-UI classes running now (runs/cov-rest).
